date_evidence: Day-specific first public posting verified for the 2002 online article; the earlier cited 1994 printed paper has no verified day-specific release in the inspected material.
integrity: Exact finite checks are reproducible but are not an infinite proof. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only different-class pair covariances; no claim of bipartite independence, higher-order negative association, or multivariate normality. Earlier general degree-generating functions may encode the finite covariance and create residual priority risk.
title: Universal cross-part leaf-count repulsion in random complete multipartite spanning trees
